description: A .webloc written by Finder itself on macOS 15.5 (24F74)
notes: Created with: osascript -e 'tell application "Finder" to make new internet location file at <folder> to "https://example.com/rich-clipboard" with properties {name:"Example Link"}'. Finder wrote an XML plist, not a binary one - the binary encoding comes from drag-created weblocs, not from the Finder scripting command. Two things the bytes do not show: the file also carries a com.apple.FinderInfo xattr with type 'ilht' and creator 'MACS', and a resource fork holding the legacy 'url ' resource with the same URL and a 'drag' resource. That resource fork is the pre-OS X variant, out of scope for phase 0.
